children.name: PeriodT Coach helps coaches and support
children.characters: PeriodT Coach helps coaches and support staff train female athletes with their cycle, not against it. See how each athlete is feeling, read the notes they choose to share, and adjust upcoming sessions in a few taps. Built alongside the PeriodT athlete app, it keeps the conversation about menstrual health and wellbeing open, private and kind.
